A '''Troll commando''' was a type of troll wandering around [[Burthorpe]] and [[Taverley]]. It used melee and appeared to be disguised as or wearing a wolf skin. It was smaller than most human NPCs and was sometimes found with the [[Troll ranger commando]] and [[Troll mage commando]]. It droped the [[Bladestorm drape]]. They were often seen fighting with [[Patrolling Guards]].

They were replaced with [[White wolf (Burthorpe)|White wolves]], which have the same stats and drops.
